requirements: R1: The frontend login page must display an option to authenticate via Moodle SSO.
R2: The settings or role management section must display the mapping of Moodle roles to archive roles.

slices.title: Patch Moodle SSO and Role Hierarchy Interfaces
slices.jtbd: When implementing the missing Moodle interfaces for this epic, I want to expose the SSO login button and role mapping display, so that users can authenticate and administrators can verify access control.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user on the login screen, When they choose to log in, Then they should see an option to authenticate via Moodle SSO, and all actions must have visible feedback.
Given an administrator on the settings screen, When they view or configure the role management section, Then they should see the current mapping of Moodle roles to internal archive roles, the layout must be usable on a phone, and what the user typed must survive on failure.
Given the frontend patch, When the test suite runs, Then unit and E2E tests must pass to verify the SSO button and role mapping UI, providing full QA coverage for the epic.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect density in frontend role mappings
